note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 10 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation.

capabilities.decision_rights: Holds planning-level decision rights over scope baseline, work-package definition, and gate readiness recommendations; holds no implementation, procurement, provisioning, or release authorization rights.
capabilities.independence_requirement: Planning authority is separated from implementation authority; the same role may not both author a plan and authorize its execution.
capabilities.escalation_route: Unresolved planning conflicts escalate to the Executive Acceptance Authority and the future executive master-coordination gate (EXEC-MCG).

capabilities.decision_rights: Planning-level input to work-package definition-of-done and technical readiness criteria; no authority to begin construction under this package.
capabilities.independence_requirement: Construction planning is separated from independent quality assurance and from release-acceptance authority.
capabilities.escalation_route: Technical readiness disputes escalate to the Accountable Program Authority.

capabilities.decision_rights: Planning-level definition of evidence obligations and acceptance criteria; no authority to execute tests or accept releases under this package.
capabilities.independence_requirement: Assurance is organizationally independent from construction and from the role that authored the artifact under assessment.
capabilities.escalation_route: Assurance findings escalate to the Executive Acceptance Authority.
